opennyai_summary.facts: The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case no. 267C of 2022 registered under Sections 498A and 494 of the Indian Penal Code.
opennyai_summary.5_May_2025__arguments:
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier vide order dated 16.12.2024, the matter was sent to the Patna High Court, Mediation Center for reaching settlement between the parties and a report of the Mediation Centre is available on the record.
5.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
A perusal of the same would go to show that memorandum of agreement has been prepared between the parties in the Mediation Proceeding No. 1909 of 2024 dated 22.04.2025.
Hence, no dispute remains between them.

6. The application for anticipatory bail is opposed by learned A.P.P. for the State.
7.
